description: [forged] Offline validator for a Dutch BSN (Burgerservicenummer, citizen service number). Strips non-digit characters, pads 8-digit values with a leading zero to 9 digits, then applies the elfproef (eleven test): weights 9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,-1 applied to the digits must sum to a multiple of 11, and the value must not be all zeros. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))
